title: Which quantifier is doing the work?
prompt: Match each role in the archive’s metric definition of sensitivity.
hint: The order is: exists δ; for every x and ε; exists y and n.

items.text: A positive separation threshold δ, chosen once for the system.
items.label: exists

items.text: A base point x and a positive neighborhood radius ε.
items.label: every

items.text: A nearby point y and a time n, allowed to depend on x and ε.
items.label: exists

feedback.pass: The quantifier order is essential. One impressive-looking trajectory cannot discharge it.
feedback.fail: δ is uniform. The point x and radius ε are arbitrary. The witness y and time n may depend on them.
